steps.en: Point the database setting at your Redis instance
steps.zh: 把数据库配置指向你的 Redis

steps.en: Start the scheduler and the API server
steps.zh: 启动调度程序和 API 服务
steps.code: python proxyPool.py schedule · python proxyPool.py server

steps.en: On a timer, fetches candidate IPs from every enabled free-proxy source
steps.zh: 定时从所有启用的免费代理源抓候选 IP

steps.en: Tests each candidate, keeps the live ones in Redis and drops the dead
steps.zh: 逐个测试候选，活的存进 Redis，死的剔掉

steps.en: In your scraper, ask the API for a proxy before each request
steps.zh: 爬虫每次请求前向 API 要一个代理

steps.en: Returns a random currently-live proxy from the pool
steps.zh: 从池里随机返回一个当前可用的代理

value.en: Your scraper rotates through a self-refreshing set of free IPs without you maintaining a proxy list
value.zh: 爬虫在一批会自动刷新的免费 IP 之间轮换，你不用自己维护代理列表
